**Daily Devotional**

**April 28**

*4 Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth. (1 Timothy 2:4 KJV)*

This verse and 2 Peter 3:9 are two verses that make it clear that God does not want anyone to perish and go to hell. But more will not believe in Jesus and be damned than will be saved, as Jesus said more would enter the broad gate unto destruction than the narrow gate to everlasting life (Matthew 7:13-14). This shows that the teaching that God controls everything that happens is false teaching, as what God wills does not automatically come to pass. God has a perfect plan for each one of us, but we have to accept His plan for it to happen (Jeremiah 29:11). The extreme teaching that God controls everything does not agree with the Word of God (Deuteronomy 30:19).

Notice also that the Lord wishes that all men come unto the knowledge of the truth. All Christians should study the Word of God to renew their minds to the truths that are contained in the Word (Romans 12:2). By doing so, you can live the abundant life that God has provided us, not just in the bye and bye, but also in the here and now. Praise God for all the blessings He has already given us, as He has given us all spiritual blessings, in heavenly places (Ephesians 1:3), when we are born again. Thank you Lord Jesus!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
